summary.text: Angie Taylor, listed by the Nevada Legislature as Angela D. Taylor, is a Democratic state senator for District 15 in Washoe County. She has served in the Nevada Senate since 2024 after two years in the Nevada Assembly, and she sits on the Senate Health and Wellness Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's page says Taylor was born in San Francisco in 1963 and lists her occupation as consultant.
It lists three University of Nevada, Reno degrees: a B.S. in business administration, an M.P.A. in public administration and policy, and an Ed.D. in educational leadership.
Taylor served in the Nevada Assembly from 2022 to 2024, having first been elected in November 2022, and was first elected to the Senate in November 2024.
The page also lists her as a member of the Washoe County School District Board of Trustees since 2014.
